resolvedSinceInitialBaseline.summary: CookingResearchPanel (SS-005) is merged to main and mounted in CookingScreen via ResearchPanelClient (PR #61), preventing duplicate initial requests and wiring explicit substitution confirmation into session.confirmedFacts.

Session Start/Stop, Mute, message input, and Research button moved to a sticky bottom _controlDock outside generated workspace scrolling (PR #64); awaiting post-deploy hosted and physical phone verification.
show_cooking_ui now requires stepId and rejects stale generated workspaces after step advancement (PR #56).

defects.title: Dinner review masks HTTP 403/400/409 server rejections as ambiguous delivery status and locks the dialog
defects.expected: When POST /api/dinner-ready returns HTTP 403 (recipient-not-allowed) or 400 (invalid-recipient) before claiming any ledger entry, the UI surfaces the rejection reason and lets the cook edit the recipient.
defects.actual: sendDinnerMessage throws StateError on any non-200 HTTP status; _reviewDinner catches all errors and sets result = 'Message status could not be confirmed. No automatic resend will occur.', disabling the Recipient field, Message field, and Confirm button.

defects.title: _notificationId is allocated once per _CookingScreenState lifetime, causing 409 idempotency-conflict if edited after a claimed failure
defects.expected: Distinct review attempts after a non-pending validation or configuration fix do not collide on a stale notificationId with a different message/recipient fingerprint.
defects.actual: _CookingScreenState initializes final _notificationId = const Uuid().v4() once. Editing the message in a reopened dialog after a claimed attempt causes 409 idempotency-conflict on the backend.

defects.title: Answering a cook clarification (ask_cook / cookQuestion) leaves the question panel and option buttons active in the GenUI workspace until a new workspace arrives
defects.expected: Confirming an answer immediately transitions or disables the active question/cookQuestion GenUI panel locally so repeated taps on option buttons cannot append duplicate confirmed facts before the model responds.
defects.actual: confirmCookAnswer sets cookQuestion = null and saves the fact, but leaves the GenUI 'question' or 'cookQuestion' panel mounted with active OutlinedButton options until a later show_cooking_ui replaces the surface.

defects.title: Tapping Research a cooking question (Icons.travel_explore) in _controlDock with an empty input box only populates text without focusing or starting research
defects.expected: Tapping the Research a cooking question icon button with an empty input either focuses the seeded prompt with a clear cue or initiates research directly.
defects.actual: The first tap silently assigns _message.text = 'Can I use vinegar instead of lemon in this recipe?' without focusing the field or calling cook.researchQuestionNow, requiring a second tap on Icons.travel_explore.

defects.title: ingredientChecklist uses CheckboxListTile(dense: true), reducing touch target height below 48dp on mobile viewports
defects.expected: Mobile touch controls maintain >=48dp vertical tap target height at 1.0x text scale.
defects.actual: CheckboxListTile in ingredientChecklist sets dense: true and contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero, yielding ~40dp row height for single-line ingredient items at 1.0x text scale.
